lines: I want something that never loses.
I want love that’s just for me.
If we do that, surely we will.
Be able to stay without comparing.
I want all sorts of reasons.
I feel like I’m alone, just me.
When the night is lonely,
I need something to cling to.
I feel envious.
It’s just empty.
I don’t want to be hated, but.
I want to keep liking myself.
Darling, swim on my back.
Because the sea of hopeless days is so deep.
I wanted to be someone else’s me.
Because I end up misunderstanding.
Don’t leave me alone.
La-la, ooh
La-la, ooh
I want something I can believe in.
I want a bond that can’t be untied.
If we do that, surely we will.
Be able to stay without being disgusted.
It’s okay to cherish it.
When my bravado crumbles at night,
I curl up, shrinking in the futon.
I feel envious.
It’s just empty.
Even on the path I chose.
I sometimes end up looking back.
Darling, rest in my arms.
Because those who are unbearably sad are very weak.
I wanted to be someone else’s me.
Because I end up wandering.
Don’t leave me alone.
I’m going crazy because of this limited world.
Smoldering in endless time.
Just because I’m the same as everyone.
My, mine.
Pretending doesn’t make it easier.
Darling, listen to the true sound.
Even though the pus of hopeless days never fully drains.
Hey, it’s okay to stay as my own self.
I can’t become that girl.
I don’t need to become one.
Darling, darling
Darling, darling
Darling, darling
Darling, darling
Darling, darling
Darling, darling
